business_problem: MIKOPTIK needed to reduce the time engineers spent finding R&D knowledge and coordinating across siloed systems because access to design expertise depended too heavily on a small number of key specialists.
solution_summary: With support from XPower and IBM, MIKOPTIK built an automated knowledge-base management system for its R&D lifecycle. IBM watsonx Assistant acts as the virtual assistant interface, IBM Watson Discovery handles data discovery, classification, and content management, IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation automates the supporting workflows and data retrieval, and IBM Cloud Pak for Integration connects the company's previously siloed R&D systems. By combining watsonx Assistant, Watson Discovery, and large language models, the solution lets engineering and production teams query technical information in natural language and receive the right product, design, and blueprinting content more quickly. The same architecture improves collaboration because it unifies access to information across multiple applications rather than leaving knowledge trapped with a handful of engineers. In effect, MIKOPTIK turned scattered R&D content into a searchable, workflow-connected engineering knowledge layer.
products_used: IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Provides the natural-language interface used by engineers to access R&D knowledge.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery

data_flow: R&D information from design and engineering systems is connected through Cloud Pak for Integration, classified and retrieved with Watson Discovery, exposed to users through watsonx Assistant, and coordinated with Cloud Pak for Business Automation so teams can find and act on technical knowledge faster.
business_outcome: MIKOPTIK improved access to engineering information, shortened the handoff from design to production planning, and raised service quality by making critical R&D knowledge easier to find and reuse.
